name: messaging-send-apns-critical-sound
description: firebase-admin/messaging CriticalSound: FCM accepts aps.sound critical dictionary with name and volume in [0, 1], while empty name or out-of-range volume fails client preflight with messaging/invalid-payload.

emptySoundName.message: apns.payload.aps.sound.name must be a non-empty string
emptySoundName.name: Error

negativeVolume.message: apns.payload.aps.sound.volume must be in the interval [0, 1]
negativeVolume.name: Error

volumeAboveOne.message: apns.payload.aps.sound.volume must be in the interval [0, 1]
volumeAboveOne.name: Error
